metadata.purpose: Mechanism-curated candidate panel for research prioritisation. Not a prescribing, efficacy, or co-administration dataset.

schema.target_effects: signed unitless directional hypotheses in [-1,1]; not affinities or doses
schema.cns_penetration: 0-1 ordinal confidence that the agent reaches CNS parenchyma at therapeutic exposure
schema.compartment: dominant site of action: peripheral | cns | both
schema.safety_burden: 0-1 ordinal, ranking-relevant risk magnitude per domain: infection, malignancy, cardiac, hepatic, teratogenicity, autoimmunity, ocular
schema.target_family: biological target group; agents sharing one are pharmacodynamically redundant regardless of modality and are never ranked as a combination

metadata.curation_rule: Approved MS disease-modifying therapies, late-stage clinical candidates, and mechanism-diverse repurposing/preclinical agents. Records marked as negative or safety controls are retained deliberately and must not be filtered out. Every record requires independent verification before publication use.

drugs.name: Alemtuzumab
drugs.curation_note: Profound depletion followed by reconstitution; high secondary autoimmunity.

drugs.name: Bexarotene
drugs.primary_moa: Retinoid X receptor agonist promoting remyelination
drugs.curation_note: Remyelination signal offset by a poor tolerability profile in trial.

drugs.name: Cholecalciferol
drugs.curation_note: Adjunct evidence; not established as monotherapy DMT.

drugs.name: Clemastine
drugs.primary_moa: M1 muscarinic antagonism promoting OPC differentiation

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.curation_note: High-burden rescue therapy; useful as a safety-penalty stress test.

drugs.name: Daclizumab
drugs.curation_note: Withdrawn worldwide for fatal immune hepatitis/encephalitis. Retained as a safety-penalty positive control: any ranking that promotes it is wrong.

drugs.name: Evobrutinib
drugs.curation_note: Phase 3 did not meet its primary endpoint; retained as a mechanism control.

drugs.name: High-dose biotin
drugs.curation_note: Phase 3 (SPI2) was negative; retained as a metabolic mechanism control.

drugs.name: Ibudilast
drugs.primary_moa: PDE4/10 and MIF inhibition, glial modulation

drugs.name: Inebilizumab
drugs.curation_note: Approved in NMOSD, not MS; included for CD19-vs-CD20 mechanism contrast.

drugs.name: Lamotrigine
drugs.curation_note: Phase 2 in SPMS did not show benefit on the primary endpoint.

drugs.name: Laquinimod
drugs.curation_note: Development halted at higher doses for cardiovascular findings.

drugs.name: Masitinib
drugs.primary_moa: c-Kit/CSF1R mast cell and microglial TKI

drugs.name: Methylprednisolone
drugs.curation_note: Relapse rescue only; not a disease-modifying maintenance therapy.

drugs.name: Miconazole
drugs.curation_note: Systemic exposure and CNS delivery are unresolved barriers.

drugs.name: Mitoxantrone
drugs.curation_note: Cumulative-dose-limited; retained mainly as a mechanistic anchor.

drugs.name: Natalizumab
drugs.curation_note: PML risk drives the dominant safety burden, JCV-status dependent.

drugs.name: Natalizumab-biosimilar
drugs.curation_note: Mechanistic duplicate of natalizumab; acts as a positive control pair.

drugs.name: Opicinumab
drugs.curation_note: Phase 2 endpoints were not met; retained as a remyelination mechanism anchor.

drugs.name: Pioglitazone
drugs.primary_moa: PPAR-gamma agonism, metabolic and glial effects

drugs.name: Quetiapine
drugs.curation_note: Rodent remyelination signal only; sedation limits translatability.

drugs.name: Resveratrol
drugs.curation_note: Preclinical MS evidence is mixed, including reports of harm in EAE.

drugs.name: Riluzole
drugs.primary_moa: Glutamate release inhibition, Na channel block

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.curation_note: Widely used off-label; included for mechanism-class breadth.

drugs.name: Temelimab
drugs.curation_note: Targets a putative viral driver; efficacy evidence remains preliminary.

drugs.name: Tolebrutinib
drugs.curation_note: CNS penetration is the differentiating claim; hepatic signal is dose-limiting.

drugs.name: Ustekinumab
drugs.curation_note: Phase 2 in MS was negative; a valuable negative mechanistic control.
